_readme: A real save in the version 8 shape - a party WITH magic, a bag, a purse and worn gear, and nobody else - pinned so the v8->v9 step is tested against a FILE rather than a dictionary a test just built. It carries all five on purpose: the step must add an empty companions map without dropping any of them, and a fixture missing one could not tell the difference. It is also the shape every save on every player's disk has today, which is the population this step actually has to carry.
